title: 第8章 给点银子花花？
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这竖子说什么？

钱荀被惊得目瞪口呆。

“哈哈哈。”钱世康大笑，用力揽了揽张宁的肩膀，“宁弟果然非同凡响。”

“噗！”

憋了一路笑的马守正，彻底忍不住了，笑得直呛鼻子。

一个酷爱别人的娘子，一个还没进门，就要找小娘子。

你们俩还真不愧是低山臭水啊。

钱荀回过神来，忍不住多看了张宁几眼。

这竖子，脸上满是对女人的渴望！

一时间，连他都有些迷糊了。

难道这竖子，真的跟传闻中一样，是连钱世康这种草包都不如的废物？

“看什么？”张宁有些恼羞成怒道，“嫌弃本皇子现在只是个落魄县令？看不上本皇子？有眼无珠的老东西，不怕告诉你，本皇子早晚有一天，会成为这天下的共主。”

“到时，你奉上的妙龄女子，便是我大乾母仪天下的皇后。如此良机，千载难逢。你这老东西，别不识抬举！”

闻言，钱荀彻底不怀疑了。

这竖子就是一个连钱世康都不如的废物。

也是，若非如此，这俩人怎么会一见如故呢？

“不敢不敢。”钱荀的眼底，迅速闪过一抹嘲弄，面上却正色道，“非是老夫不识抬举，更不敢欺瞒大人，实在是我钱家人丁稀疏，巧妇难为无米之炊啊。”

张宁有些失望，“那你们钱家，还真是福缘浅薄啊。”

“是是是。”钱荀不想继续这个话题，连忙敷衍点头。

钱世康却像是想到了什么似的，“大伯，怎么就巧妇难为无米之炊了？我不是还有个守身如玉的嫂嫂吗？”

闻言，钱荀脸色顿时一沉，看向钱世康的眼神里，甚至有了一丝杀意。

张宁也懵逼地看了眼钱世康，这泌阳的孟德之风如此浑厚，根子该不会是觊觎他的嫂嫂吧？

What did this guy say?

Qian Xun was stunned.

"Hahaha." Qian Shikang laughed and put his arm around Zhang Ning's shoulders, "Brother Ning is indeed extraordinary."

"Poof!"

Ma Shouzheng, who had been holding back his laughter, couldn't bear it anymore and laughed until his nose choked.

A lady who loves others very much will look for a young lady before she even enters the house.

You two are really worthy of being in the low mountains and smelly water.

Qian Xun came to his senses and couldn't help but look at Zhang Ning a few more times.

This guy's face is full of desire for women!

For a moment, even he was a little confused.

Could it be that this guy is really as useless as the rumors say, even worse than a loser like Qian Shikang?

"What are you looking at?" Zhang Ning said with some embarrassment, "Do you dislike this prince who is just a down-and-out county magistrate? Look down on me? I am a blind old man who is not afraid to tell you that one day, sooner or later, I will become the co-owner of this world."

"When the time comes, the young woman you present will be the queen of my great mother-in-law. Such a good opportunity is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. You old man, you don't know how to praise me!"

After hearing this, Qian Xun had no doubts at all.

This Zhuzi is a waste that is worse than even Qian Shikang.

Also, if not for this, how could these two people hit it off?

"Don't you dare." Qian Xun's eyes quickly flashed with mockery, but his face said seriously, "It's not that I don't know how to show appreciation, and I don't dare to deceive you. It's true that my Qian family is sparse, and it's hard for a clever woman to make a living without rice."

Zhang Ning was a little disappointed, "Then your Qian family really has little luck."

"Yes, yes." Qian Xun didn't want to continue this topic and nodded perfunctorily.

Qian Shikang seemed to have thought of something, "Uncle, why is it so difficult for a clever woman to make a living without rice? Don't I have a sister-in-law who is as protective as a jade?"

Hearing this, Qian Xun's face suddenly darkened, and there was even a hint of murderous intent in his eyes when he looked at Qian Shikang.

Zhang Ning also glanced at Qian Shikang in confusion. Biyang's Meng De style was so strong. Could it be that he coveted his sister-in-law?
